help: deposit the forge's ledger - issues, pull requests, comments, reviews, labels, blocked_by edges, the repository record - under data/input/github/forge/gh-CLI/<stamp>/, one file per read; every run deposits, and a deposit holds only what the forge returned

args.name: --to
args.help: deposit under a directory instead of the store (test escape hatch - a directory, never a machine name)

gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues: reads every issue and pull request, and each issue's blocked_by edges
gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls: reads every pull request, its reviews and review comments
gh api graphql: reads every pull request's review count in one paginated query, so only reviewed pulls are read one by one
